note: Large KOA Resort on Music Valley Drive near the Opryland area, with a pool; value water/electric and full-hookup sites in the South Section, patio and premium sites in the North Section, most of them pull-through. --Claude
summary: Nashville KOA Resort confirmed: open all year, $39 (January value W/E) to $249 (May Signature) before tax; 50-amp full hookups. Under the gate on the $39 January value site (and gateway Nashville ~11 km anyway). Google 4.3 (2,502). Pin at the entrance, ~200 m from the loops - fine.
flags: PRICE: fees 59-179 -> 39-249. Cheapest real RV night $39 (Pull Thru 50/30 W/E, South Section, 2027-01-12) - under $50; December's cheapest was $60 and May's $59.
